Fact.Name: Gross earned income
Fact.Description: Monthly earned income before taxes (wages, salary, self-employment)

Fact.Name: Unearned income
Fact.Description: Monthly unearned income (Social Security, unemployment, child support, etc.)

Fact.Name: Dependent care expenses
Fact.Description: Monthly out-of-pocket dependent care costs

Fact.Name: Rent
Fact.Description: Monthly rent paid

Fact.Name: Real estate taxes
Fact.Description: Monthly property taxes

Fact.Name: HOA fees
Fact.Description: Monthly homeowners association fees

Fact.Name: Mortgage payments
Fact.Description: Monthly mortgage payments

Fact.Name: Homeowners insurance
Fact.Description: Monthly homeowners insurance

Fact.Name: Household members
Fact.Description: List of household members

Fact.Name: Is elderly
Fact.Description: Whether this member is age 60+

Fact.Name: Is disabled
Fact.Description: Whether this member is disabled

Fact.Name: Medical expenses
Fact.Description: This member's monthly out-of-pocket medical expenses

Fact.Name: Age
Fact.Description: Age of this member in years

Fact.Name: Higher-ed student
Fact.Description: Whether this member is enrolled at least half-time in higher education (the base criterion for the SNAP student exclusion)

Fact.Name: Weekly work hours
Fact.Description: Hours this member works per week

Fact.Name: Work-study
Fact.Description: Whether this member participates in a federal or state work-study program

Fact.Name: Is parent
Fact.Description: Whether this member is a parent (tax-unit head or spouse) in the household

Fact.Name: Full-time college student
Fact.Description: Whether this member is enrolled full-time in higher education (required for the single-parent student exception)

Fact.Name: Receives TANF
Fact.Description: Whether this member receives Temporary Assistance for Needy Families benefits

Fact.Name: Immigration eligible
Fact.Description: Whether this member has an immigration status that qualifies for SNAP

Fact.Name: Is pregnant
Fact.Description: Whether this member is pregnant (exempt from ABAWD work requirements, 7 USC § 2015(o)(3)(E))

Fact.Name: Incapable of self-care
Fact.Description: Whether this member is incapable of caring for themselves (household member caring for them is exempt from general work requirements)

Fact.Name: ABAWD countable months used
Fact.Description: Number of months in the last 36-month window where this member received SNAP without meeting the ABAWD work requirement (7 CFR § 273.24(b)(1)(i))

Fact.Name: Cash on hand
Fact.Description: Currency and cash this member holds

Fact.Name: Bank account assets
Fact.Description: Balances in checking and savings accounts

Fact.Name: Stock assets
Fact.Description: Value of countable stock holdings

Fact.Name: Bond assets
Fact.Description: Value of countable bond holdings

Fact.Name: Meets categorical eligibility
Fact.Description: Whether the household qualifies via SSI/TANF or broad-based categorical eligibility (BBCE), which overrides the income and asset tests

Fact.Name: Child support paid
Fact.Description: Monthly legally-obligated child support payments (Colorado treats this as an income exclusion, not a deduction)

Fact.Name: Homeless household
Fact.Description: Whether the household is homeless (eligible to elect the flat homeless shelter deduction)

Fact.Name: Earned income deduction rate
Fact.Description: 20% earned income deduction per 7 USC 2014(e)(1)

Fact.Name: Excess shelter deduction cap
Fact.Description: Cap on excess shelter deduction for non-elderly/disabled households

Fact.Name: Homeless shelter deduction
Fact.Description: Flat shelter deduction homeless households may elect instead of the calculated excess shelter deduction (FY2026)

Fact.Name: SUA amount
Fact.Description: Standard Utility Allowance — Colorado uses SUA for any household with a utility expense

Fact.Name: Student age lower threshold
Fact.Description: Higher-ed students under this age are exempt from the SNAP student exclusion

Fact.Name: Student age upper threshold
Fact.Description: Higher-ed students at or above this age are exempt from the SNAP student exclusion

Fact.Name: Student weekly work hours threshold
Fact.Description: Higher-ed students working at least this many hours per week are exempt from the student exclusion

Fact.Name: Two-parent child age limit
Fact.Description: Upper age threshold for a dependent child that qualifies the parent exception in a two-parent household (7 USC § 2015(e)(5)(A))

Fact.Name: Single-parent child age limit
Fact.Description: Upper age threshold for a dependent child that qualifies the parent exception for a single-parent full-time student (7 USC § 2015(e)(8))

Fact.Name: General work exempt age (upper)
Fact.Description: Members under this age are exempt from general work requirements

Fact.Name: General work exempt age (lower)
Fact.Description: Members at or above this age are exempt from general work requirements

Fact.Name: General work weekly hours threshold
Fact.Description: Weekly hours needed to satisfy general work requirements

Fact.Name: General caring-dependent-child age limit
Fact.Description: Caring for a dependent child under this age exempts a member from general work requirements

Fact.Name: ABAWD exempt age (upper)
Fact.Description: Members under this age are exempt from ABAWD work requirements

Fact.Name: ABAWD exempt age (lower)
Fact.Description: Members at or above this age are exempt from ABAWD work requirements (post-HR1)

Fact.Name: ABAWD work weekly hours threshold
Fact.Description: Weekly hours needed to satisfy ABAWD work requirements

Fact.Name: ABAWD dependent-child age limit
Fact.Description: A parent with a dependent under this age is exempt from ABAWD work requirements (post-HR1)

Fact.Name: ABAWD countable months limit
Fact.Description: Maximum countable months a member may receive SNAP without meeting ABAWD work requirements in a 36-month period (7 CFR § 273.24(b)(1))

Fact.Name: Asset limit (standard)
Fact.Description: Maximum countable assets for households without an elderly or disabled member

Fact.Name: Asset limit (elderly/disabled)
Fact.Description: Maximum countable assets for households with an elderly or disabled member

Fact.Name: Medical deduction threshold
Fact.Description: Only medical expenses above this threshold are deductible

Fact.Name: Benefit reduction rate
Fact.Description: Households expected to spend 30% of net income on food

Fact.Name: Shelter income share rate
Fact.Description: Shelter costs exceeding this share of adjusted income are deductible per 7 USC 2014(e)(6)

Fact.Name: Minimum benefit rate
Fact.Description: Minimum benefit as a share of the 1-person max allotment (8%)

Fact.Name: Minimum benefit
Fact.Description: Minimum monthly benefit for 1-2 person households: 8% of the 1-person max allotment, rounded to the nearest whole dollar

Fact.Name: Gross income limit rate
Fact.Description: Gross income must be at or below 130% of FPL

Fact.Name: Net income limit rate
Fact.Description: Net income must be at or below 100% of FPL

Fact.Name: FPL annual per additional person
Fact.Description: Additional annual FPL amount for each person beyond the first

Fact.Name: Max allotment per additional person
Fact.Description: Additional max allotment per person beyond 8

Fact.Name: Is elderly or disabled
Fact.Description: Whether this member is age 60+ or disabled

Fact.Name: Meets student age exception
Fact.Description: Under 18 or age 50 or older (exception 1)

Fact.Name: Meets student work exception
Fact.Description: Employed at least 20 hours per week, or participates in work-study (exception 4)

Fact.Name: Is child under two-parent age limit
Fact.Description: Whether this member is younger than the two-parent child age threshold (6)

Fact.Name: Is child under single-parent age limit
Fact.Description: Whether this member is younger than the single-parent child age threshold (12)

Fact.Name: Meets single-parent student exception
Fact.Description: Single parent enrolled full-time with a dependent child under 12 — 7 USC § 2015(e)(8)

Fact.Name: Meets parent exception
Fact.Description: Whether this member qualifies for the SNAP student parent exception: is a parent AND either the household has a child under 6, or this member is a single full-time-student parent with a child under 12

Fact.Name: Meets any student exception
Fact.Description: At least one of the statutory student-exclusion exceptions applies: age, disability, work, parent, or TANF

Fact.Name: SNAP-ineligible student
Fact.Description: Higher-ed student who fails every statutory exception

Fact.Name: Is child under ABAWD dependent age limit
Fact.Description: Whether this member is younger than the ABAWD dependent-child threshold

Fact.Name: Is child under general caring age limit
Fact.Description: Whether this member is younger than the general work caring-dependent-child threshold

Fact.Name: Meets general work age exemption
Fact.Description: Under 16 or age 60 or older — exempt from general work requirements

Fact.Name: Meets ABAWD age exemption
Fact.Description: Under 18 or age 65 or older — exempt from ABAWD work requirements (post-HR1)

Fact.Name: Meets general work hours threshold
Fact.Description: Works at least 30 hours per week

Fact.Name: Meets ABAWD work hours threshold
Fact.Description: Works at least 20 hours per week

Fact.Name: Meets general work requirements
Fact.Description: Age-exempt, disabled, caring for a dependent child under 6 or an incapable member, or working ≥30 hours/week

Fact.Name: Has ABAWD months remaining
Fact.Description: Whether this member still has countable SNAP months available in the 36-month window

Fact.Name: Meets ABAWD work requirements
Fact.Description: Age-exempt, working ≥20 hours/week, disabled, pregnant, a parent of a child under the ABAWD dependent threshold, or still within the 3-month countable allowance in the 36-month window

Fact.Name: Satisfies ABAWD
Fact.Description: Whether this member is OK under ABAWD rules this month: household has a dependent child under the ABAWD age threshold, OR the member personally meets ABAWD work requirements

Fact.Name: Meets work requirements
Fact.Description: Meets general work requirements and satisfies ABAWD rules

Fact.Name: Is eligible member
Fact.Description: Whether this member personally qualifies for SNAP: not a SNAP-ineligible student, has a qualifying immigration status, and meets work requirements

Fact.Name: SNAP assets
Fact.Description: Countable liquid resources held by this member (cash, bank, stock, bond) per 7 CFR § 273.8(c)(1)

Fact.Name: Countable medical expenses
Fact.Description: Medical expenses if the member is elderly or disabled; $0 otherwise

Fact.Name: Household size
Fact.Description: Number of eligible members in the SNAP household

Fact.Name: Elderly or disabled member
Fact.Description: Whether the household has any member who is age 60+ or disabled

Fact.Name: Parent count
Fact.Description: Number of members flagged as parents (tax-unit head or spouse)

Fact.Name: Has child under two-parent limit
Fact.Description: Whether the household has any member under age 6 (two-parent parent exception threshold)

Fact.Name: Has child under single-parent limit
Fact.Description: Whether the household has any member under age 12 (single-parent parent exception threshold)

Fact.Name: Has dependent child under ABAWD limit
Fact.Description: Whether the household has any member under the ABAWD dependent-child age threshold (14 post-HR1)

Fact.Name: Has caring-dependent child
Fact.Description: Whether the household has any member under the general work caring-dependent-child threshold (6)

Fact.Name: Has incapable member
Fact.Description: Whether the household has any member incapable of self-care

Fact.Name: Medical expenses (elderly/disabled)
Fact.Description: Sum of monthly out-of-pocket medical expenses across elderly/disabled members

Fact.Name: SNAP assets
Fact.Description: Total countable liquid resources across all household members

Fact.Name: Asset limit
Fact.Description: Applicable asset limit for this household: elderly/disabled amount if any member is age 60+ or disabled, otherwise the standard amount

Fact.Name: Meets asset test
Fact.Description: Whether the household's countable resources are at or below the applicable SNAP asset limit

Fact.Name: Utility allowance
Fact.Description: Colorado always applies the full SUA

Fact.Name: Shelter costs
Fact.Description: Total monthly shelter costs: housing expenses + utility allowance

Fact.Name: Gross monthly income
Fact.Description: Earned + unearned income, minus child support paid (Colorado treats child support as an income exclusion).

Fact.Name: Federal poverty level (annual)
Fact.Description: Annual FPL for this household size: 1-person amount + (householdSize − 1) × per-additional

Fact.Name: Federal poverty level (monthly)
Fact.Description: Monthly FPL = annual FPL / 12, rounded to the nearest whole dollar

Fact.Name: Gross income limit
Fact.Description: 130% of FPL — maximum gross monthly income for eligibility

Fact.Name: Passes gross income test
Fact.Description: Whether gross monthly income is at or below 130% of FPL. Elderly/disabled households are exempt from the gross income test.

Fact.Name: Earned income deduction
Fact.Description: 20% of gross earned income

Fact.Name: Standard deduction
Fact.Description: Standard deduction based on household size

Fact.Name: Medical deduction
Fact.Description: Medical expenses over $35/month for elderly/disabled members

Fact.Name: Preliminary deductions
Fact.Description: Sum of standard, earned income, dependent care, and medical deductions (all deductions except shelter)

Fact.Name: Shelter income share
Fact.Description: 50% of income after non-shelter deductions per 7 USC 2014(e)(6)

Fact.Name: Excess shelter cost
Fact.Description: Shelter costs exceeding 50% of income after other deductions

Fact.Name: Regular shelter deduction
Fact.Description: Excess shelter deduction, capped unless elderly/disabled member present

Fact.Name: Eligible for homeless shelter deduction
Fact.Description: Household is homeless AND has some shelter costs

Fact.Name: Shelter deduction
Fact.Description: Regular shelter deduction, or the flat homeless shelter deduction when eligible and greater

Fact.Name: Total deductions
Fact.Description: Sum of standard, earned income, dependent care, medical, and shelter deductions

Fact.Name: Net monthly income
Fact.Description: Gross monthly income minus total deductions

Fact.Name: Net income limit
Fact.Description: Maximum net monthly income for eligibility: netIncomeLimitRate × monthly FPL

Fact.Name: Passes net income test
Fact.Description: Whether net monthly income is at or below 100% of FPL

Fact.Name: Normal eligibility
Fact.Description: Passes gross income, net income, and asset tests (before categorical eligibility override)

Fact.Name: Has eligible person
Fact.Description: Whether the household contains at least one member who personally qualifies for SNAP (not an ineligible student, immigration-eligible, and meets work requirements)

Fact.Name: Eligible for SNAP
Fact.Description: Whether the household is eligible for SNAP benefits. Work-requirement failures, student status, and immigration status are applied as per-member exclusions (/members/*/isEligibleMember); the household is eligible as long as at least one member personally qualifies.

Fact.Name: Maximum allotment
Fact.Description: Maximum monthly SNAP benefit for this household size

Fact.Name: Expected food contribution
Fact.Description: 30% of net income — the amount the household is expected to spend on food

Fact.Name: Calculated benefit
Fact.Description: Max allotment minus 30% of net income

Fact.Name: Monthly SNAP benefit
Fact.Description: Final monthly benefit amount, zero if not eligible, with minimum benefit floor for small households
